name: EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness
notable_features: Standard harness for zero-shot and few-shot benchmark scoring (MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag, IFEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, PIQA, WinoGrande, ...)
Version-pinned task metrics matter: task versions and metric names (acc vs acc_norm, strict vs loose) change reported numbers
Used as the downstream-scoring path by several quantization papers while perplexity was computed separately by the inference engine
hardware_caveats: Not an inference engine - it scores, it does not serve. Any tok/s figure attributed to it is from a backend plugin, not from the harness itself
best_for: comparable downstream accuracy numbers across quantization formats
notes: Recorded because almost every quantization quality delta in this repo is an lm-eval number, and because the GGUF k-quant study pinned the exact harness version (v0.4.9.2) alongside its llama.cpp commit (b7600). That pairing matters: swapping harness versions has silently moved published GSM8K/MMLU/IFEval numbers before. ||| MAINTENANCE (dated fact, GitHub API, 2026-10-04): last commit 2026-09-14 (0.7 months before this record), latest release v0.4.13 published 2026-08-31, 460 contributors (distinct committers including anonymous), open_issues_count 1115 (issues PLUS pull requests - see [[ev-github-open-issues-count-includes-pull-requests]]), not archived, 14129 stars.
